opus.problem: In the clue, 'its belly' refers to the great fish, so the clue points to the fish, not the word. The verse says 'the belly of Sheol', which the clue does not show.

Most clues fit 'death' or 'the grave' just as well (Hezekiah's gates, Jacob going down, Korah going down alive, Hosea's sting). Clue 5 even sits beside 'Death' in the same verse. Nothing in the 7 clues sets Sheol apart from these, so they do not fit only this word.
